stappen: Preheat the oven to 175 °C (conventional). Boil the potatoes in salted water for about 20 min and drain.
Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 2–3 min and set aside.
Fry the mushrooms until the liquid has evaporated and they start to brown (about 8 min). Do not add salt yet.
Add a splash of oil, the onion and garlic and fry for 3 min. Add the paprika, {¾ tsp} onion powder, chilli flakes, pepper and soy sauce.
Add the leek and walnuts and cook gently. Season with curry powder and salt to taste. The mixture should be fairly dry.
Mix the crème fraîche, milk, {¼ tsp} onion powder, garlic powder, egg, parsley, salt and pepper.
Mash the potatoes with a splash of milk, {1 tbsp} crème fraîche, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Spoon the mushroom mixture into an ovenproof dish of about 20 x 15 cm, pour the cream mixture over it, spread the mash on top and sprinkle with the cheese.
Bake for 20–25 min until golden brown.
tips: Fry the mushrooms dry and only add salt at the end, otherwise the bake turns watery.
Can be made ahead: assemble now and bake later. It freezes well, before or after baking; reheat covered with foil, 15 min at 180 °C.
Alternatives to the mushroom and walnut filling: vegetarian mince (1 for 1), lentils ({250 g} from a tin), chickpeas or TVP ({50 g} dry, soaked).
